title: SprintMomentum
description: As you sprint you slowly build momentum allowing you to go faster.
body:
SprintMomentum is a mod that allows you to gain momentum while sprinting (Crazy right).

While sprinting your xp bar will be taken over to indicate how high your momentum is gradually going from green to red and filling up.

![Momentum Bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edd5325c95de8d068fc6e8ff60d5239c52e937cd.png)

However the moment you stop sprinting your momentum bar will quickly go down as you lose momentum so dont stop.

![Be Careful not to stop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c46fe446c0ef49755eb02aa1e5708eaccab497b_0.webp)

jumping also reduces your momentum by almost half because of all the effort it takes to jump.

All of this is configurable just make sure you have Mod Menu and Cloth Config installed :)
